name: manual_135fb6
claim: Chain every step of a worktree or branch operation with and-and and run git with an explicit absolute directory: a failed worktree add followed by a failed cd let a merge run in the main checkout, and only an immediate abort and a clean-status check undid it.
conditions: git worktree cd chain merge abort absolute

decisions.notes: 2026-11-26 incident: git worktree add failed because the branch existed, cd into the missing path failed, and git merge ran in the primary checkout; it had no conflicts and was aborted at once, leaving the checkout at its original head.

rationale: 2026-11-26 incident: git worktree add failed because the branch existed, cd into the missing path failed, and git merge ran in the primary checkout; it had no conflicts and was aborted at once, leaving the checkout at its original head.
